Type: desk
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Desk Table, 51.18"W, Espresso
Colors: Walnut
This sturdy industrial table provides ample space for coworkers to collaborate on projects or to spread out necessary documents for review. Well-hidden pencil drawers allow you to keep tools and supplies close at hand. 51.18"W x 23.62"D x 30.71"H Mango wood with black carbon finish This sturdy table is a convenient size for multiple uses. Two pencil drawers below desktop provide easy storage. This industrial table has an attractive carbon finish. Its ample size allows for a myriad of uses in your office. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
